colonyloom.trait.abrasive.desc: Says what they think. Often hurtful.
colonyloom.trait.sickly.desc: Falls ill often and recovers slowly.
colonyloom.trait.night_owl.desc: Goes to bed and rises late.
colonyloom.trait.early_bird.desc: Goes to bed and rises early.
colonyloom.trait.romantic.desc: Falls in love often and beautifully.
colonyloom.trait.caring.desc: Helps the sick and children; isolates when contagious.
colonyloom.trait.hypochondriac.desc: Every sneeze is a reason to panic.
colonyloom.thought.was_tended: A doctor took care of me
colonyloom.thought.colony_baby: A baby was born in the colony
screen.colonyloom.health.pregnant_detail: The baby is born at term while the mother is in the colony
command.colonyloom.life.no_life: This resident has no life yet: the simulation is off or they just appeared
command.colonyloom.life.not_infected: %s was not infected: immune or already ill
colonyloom.speech.chat.3: Heard what's going on next door?
colonyloom.speech.chat.6: Still can't get used to all these blocks.
colonyloom.speech.chat.7: They say creepers were about again last night.
colonyloom.speech.chat.8: Nice place we've got, isn't it?
colonyloom.speech.deep_talk.4: One day I'd love to build my own house.
colonyloom.speech.joke.1: Why is the creeper sad? Nobody hugs it!
colonyloom.speech.joke.2: A skeleton walks into a tavern…
colonyloom.speech.joke.3: %s, there's a chicken on your head! Kidding.
colonyloom.speech.joke.4: Ha, an enderman in the rain!
colonyloom.speech.joke.5: My brick is smarter than me, honest.
colonyloom.speech.joke.6: What do you call a zombie chef? Brainy!
colonyloom.speech.joke.7: Don't laugh, but I fell in a pit again.
colonyloom.speech.compliment.3: You're always easy to be around.
colonyloom.speech.compliment.6: It'd be dull here without you.
colonyloom.speech.kind_words.1: Hang in there, %s, it'll be fine.
colonyloom.speech.kind_words.3: I'm here if you need me.
colonyloom.speech.gossip.1: Did you hear about those two?..
colonyloom.speech.gossip.3: I saw who swiped the bread again!
colonyloom.speech.gossip.4: They say someone here's in love…
colonyloom.speech.complain.2: My back hurts, my feet hurt…
colonyloom.speech.complain.5: Too much work, too little bread.
colonyloom.speech.share_news.2: Wolves were seen in the woods.
colonyloom.speech.share_news.3: They say the harvest will be good.
colonyloom.speech.teach_craft.1: Look, %s, hold the tool like this.
colonyloom.speech.teach_medicine.2: Rest and water bring a fever down.
colonyloom.speech.teach_medicine.3: Keep the contagious away from the rest.
colonyloom.speech.teach_medicine.4: Calm is the heart of healing.
colonyloom.speech.advice.2: Get to bed early, you'll feel better.
colonyloom.speech.advice.4: Don't go out at night without a torch.
colonyloom.speech.advice.5: Look after your health while young.
colonyloom.speech.insult.2: Even a zombie's smarter than you!
colonyloom.speech.insult.7: Who even let you in here?
colonyloom.speech.slight.5: Do you always do it like that?
colonyloom.speech.comfort.2: Come here, let me hug you.
colonyloom.speech.comfort.5: Let's take a walk, it'll help.
colonyloom.speech.romance.1: %s, I think I've fallen for you.
colonyloom.speech.romance.3: I've wanted to tell you for so long…
colonyloom.speech.romance.4: With you I feel calm and happy.
colonyloom.speech.sweet_talk.5: With you, to the ends of the world.
colonyloom.speech.proposal.2: I want to spend my life with you.
colonyloom.speech.tell_story.1: Once upon a time there was a little creeper…
colonyloom.speech.tell_story.2: Far away in the End lived a dragon…
colonyloom.speech.tell_story.4: And then the brave villager took a sword…
colonyloom.speech.tell_story.5: And they lived happily ever after.
colonyloom.speech.kids_play.2: I'm the knight, you're the dragon!
colonyloom.speech.walk.2: Fresh air is the best medicine.
colonyloom.speech.chat_with_friend.2: I need someone to talk to.
colonyloom.speech.stargaze.2: That one looks like a creeper.
colonyloom.speech.sing.1: ♪ Over the hills and far away… ♪
colonyloom.speech.break.hide_away.3: I don't want to see anyone.
Someone's going to hear it now!
colonyloom.speech.recovered.2: How good it is to be healthy!
colonyloom.speech.symptom.vomit.1: Oh, I'm going to be sick…
colonyloom.speech.symptom.anxiety.2: Something bad will happen, I feel it.
colonyloom.speech.tend_patient.1: Hold still, this will only sting a little.
colonyloom.speech.tend_patient.3: You will be on your feet soon.
